# Lex Plataformae (English)

> English version of lexplataformae.com.br, which adapts the doctoral thesis by Victor L. P. Andrade, "Do regime jurídico do Objeto Imaterial de Consumo (OIC) sob a Lex Plataformae" (UNESP, Franca, 2026), on the legal regime of the Immaterial Object of Consumption (IOC) under Brazilian consumer law. Literal quotations appear in free translation, with the Portuguese original alongside. The full thesis text is a machine translation, reviewed for continuity but not yet reviewed by the author. The Portuguese version is authoritative.

- [Portuguese version](https://lexplataformae.com.br/llms.txt)
- [atlas.json, English](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/dados/atlas.json): concepts, definitions, delimiting criteria and readings, in free translation.
- [Thesis PDF, English translation](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/thesis/andrade-2026-thesis-ioc-lex-plataformae-en.pdf)
- [Thesis PDF, Portuguese original](https://lexplataformae.com.br/tese/andrade-2026-tese-oic-lex-plataformae.pdf)

- [Functional restoration and regime correction · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/functional-restoration/): Priority protection, whenever technically and legally feasible, must seek the functional restoration of enjoyment and the correction of the regime that made…
- [Functional value equivalence · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/functional-value-equivalence/): The platform may change, as long as what you bought keeps playing the role it had in your experience.
- [Governed enjoyment bundle · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/governed-enjoyment-bundle/): Everything you can do, show and be with what you bought, under the platform's rules.
- [Hypercuratorial anticipation · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/hypercuratorial-anticipation/): When the platform sells the future before delivering the present.
- [Identity captivity · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/identity-captivity/): [...] reinforcing a circuit of permanence that converts the individual's participation into an input of value creation for the platform. This effect can be…
- [A vocabulary for contesting digital consumption · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/): Nine names from Brazilian consumer law, each accounting for one part of what happens to what people buy in the digital world.
- [Immaterial Object of Consumption (IOC) · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/ioc/): The product you buy when its use depends on an environment that the platform governs and can change.
- [The law of the platform (Lex Plataformae) · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/lex-plataformae/): The rules that the platform writes, executes and enforces inside its own environment.
- [Meaning-vitiated consent · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/meaning-vitiated-consent/): The consumer does not merely get a piece of data wrong. They join within a frame of language that already places them outside the center of intelligibility…
- [Open auditability · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/open-auditability/): The duty to make it possible to verify what changed, why it changed and with what effect, without requiring the company to give up all its secrets.
- [Performative transparency · Concepts · Lex Plataformae](https://lexplataformae.com.br/en/concepts/performative-transparency/): Performative transparency does not consist in absence of information, but in excess, dispersion and faulty hierarchization of essential content.
